claim_summary: For an N-point unit equilateral metric with one pair shortened to r in (0,1], exact Lipschitz and free-ball volumes give a strictly concave quadratic Mahler product; for N>=4 the unique shortening optimum is (N-1)/(2(N-2)) and its relative gain tends to 9/8.
scientific_integrity: All parameter claims are supported by the analytic argument; exact and convex-hull finite checks are supplemental. An earlier equivalent theorem has not been excluded exhaustively.
scientific_limitations: Only real finite metrics with one shortened pair; no global optimization over weighted metrics or extension r>1. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed. Priority risk from alternative root-polytope formulations remains.
title: Sharp one-edge Mahler profile for finite equilateral Lipschitz-free spaces
